line: Send a message of support to someone going through a hard time.
paragraph: A young fox cub lay on a road in Nottinghamshire, England, with both back legs useless after a car struck him last June. A member of the public found him. The cub, named Chance, spent days unable to walk. Now he swims in hydrotherapy sessions. His legs are learning to move again in the water. Someone stayed long enough to see him breathe.
